newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH MAR PAPER EXPORTS VIA PORTS UP 9.6 PCT Y/Y.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH MAR PAPER EXPORTS VIA PORTS UP 9.6 PCT Y/Y.

text.p: Finnish paper exports through ports rose 9.6 percent year-on-year in March to 772,639 tonnes, the Board of Navigation said in a monthly report on Friday.
Total exports through Finnish ports rose 18 percent year-on-year to 3.03 million tonnes, it said.
Total exports through ports in the first quarter of the year were also up 18 percent, at 8.84 million tonnes, the board said.
Total imports through ports increased 0.4 percent year-on-year in March to 2.62 million tonnes and January-March imports through ports rose 7.7 percent to 7.82 million tonnes, it said.
About 80 percent of Finland's foreign trade passes through ports.
